verifies.G054-C2: renaming the entity attribute title to label through 'Rename attribute and update linked projections…' renames the field (and its entity graph node, by the existing source-local rename) and, in the same action and the same Undo, the property of the linked projection GizmoProjection (getTitle becomes getLabel). It is an explicit action, not a hook on the IDE's Rename refactoring (the released API has none), and it is offered only where the source-local rename is: a private field with @Column in an entity using only the annotations that rename admits. Accessors of the entity itself are not renamed.
